source: hand-written pairs from outside research on correlated ANY/ALL/IN, over O(x, k) and I(y, k); every label re-checked on random DuckDB databases

pairs.left: SELECT O.x, O.x > ANY (SELECT I.y FROM I WHERE I.k=O.k) AS p FROM O
pairs.right: WITH D AS (SELECT DISTINCT k FROM O), A AS (SELECT D.k, COUNT(I.present) AS n, COUNT(I.y) AS nn, MIN(I.y) AS mn, MAX(I.y) AS mx FROM D LEFT JOIN (SELECT y,k,1 AS present FROM I) I ON I.k = D.k GROUP BY D.k) SELECT O.x, CASE WHEN A.n=0 THEN FALSE WHEN O.x IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN O.x > A.mn THEN TRUE WHEN A.nn<A.n THEN NULL ELSE FALSE END AS p FROM O LEFT JOIN A ON O.k IS NOT DISTINCT FROM A.k

pairs.left: SELECT O.x,O.k FROM O WHERE O.x > ANY (SELECT I.y FROM I WHERE I.k=O.k)
pairs.right: SELECT O.x,O.k FROM O WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM I WHERE I.k=O.k AND O.x>I.y)

pairs.left: SELECT O.x,O.k FROM O WHERE O.x <= ALL (SELECT I.y FROM I WHERE I.k=O.k)
pairs.right: SELECT O.x,O.k FROM O WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM I WHERE I.k=O.k AND (O.x<=I.y) IS NOT TRUE)

pairs.left: SELECT O.x,O.k FROM O WHERE O.x IN (SELECT I.y FROM I WHERE I.k=O.k)
pairs.right: WITH D AS (SELECT DISTINCT k FROM O), Q AS (SELECT D.k,I.y FROM D JOIN I ON I.k=D.k) SELECT O.x,O.k FROM O WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Q WHERE Q.k=O.k AND Q.y=O.x)

pairs.left: SELECT O.x,O.k FROM O WHERE O.x NOT IN (SELECT I.y FROM I WHERE I.k=O.k)
pairs.right: SELECT O.x,O.k FROM O WHERE CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM I WHERE I.k=O.k) THEN TRUE WHEN O.x IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM I WHERE I.k=O.k AND I.y=O.x) THEN FALSE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM I WHERE I.k=O.k AND I.y IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE TRUE END IS TRUE

pairs.left: SELECT O.x, O.x = ANY (SELECT I.y FROM I WHERE I.k=O.k) AS p FROM O
pairs.right: WITH D AS (SELECT DISTINCT k,x FROM O), A AS (SELECT D.k,D.x,COUNT(I.present) n,COUNT(I.y) nn,MAX(CASE WHEN I.y=D.x THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) hit FROM D LEFT JOIN (SELECT y,k,1 present FROM I) I ON I.k=D.k GROUP BY D.k,D.x) SELECT O.x, CASE WHEN A.hit=1 THEN TRUE WHEN O.x IS NULL AND A.n=0 THEN FALSE WHEN A.n=0 THEN FALSE WHEN A.nn<A.n THEN NULL WHEN O.x IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE FALSE END FROM O LEFT JOIN A ON O.k IS NOT DISTINCT FROM A.k AND O.x IS NOT DISTINCT FROM A.x
